release_notes: Build 148 removes retired generic fact-creation data code that is no longer part of the quiz-only Factburst workflow.
Removes old generic project compatibility types where the current quiz application no longer depends on them.
Keeps active quiz project folders, Resolve export, installed-data migration, credential recovery and publishing safeguards unchanged.
This is a code cleanup release; quiz creation, scheduling, uploads and Autopilot behavior are intentionally unchanged.
